$comment: Tool/function schemas for calling google-oauth-cli from an LLM API.
Each tool maps 1:1 onto a CLI command and returns that command's JSON on stdout.
'openai' works with the Chat Completions and Responses APIs (type: function).
Every tool needs a 'project' argument. The CLI must be installed and the user must
have signed in once, interactively, before any tool call can succeed.

function.name: gauth_diagnose
function.description: Full health check of a Google OAuth setup: publish state, branding gaps, test users, and a specific fix for every blocker found. Call this FIRST for any 'Google login not working' issue. Returns blockers[] with stable codes: NO_TEST_USERS, NOT_PUBLISHED, BRANDING_URLS_MISSING, BRANDING_CONTACT_MISSING.

function.name: gauth_create_client
function.description: Create a Google OAuth 2.0 Web Client (client ID and secret), configuring the consent screen if it does not exist yet. Returns { clientId, clientSecret }. May take up to 3 minutes on first run while the user signs in to Google.

project.description: GCP project ID. Must already exist.

name.description: Human-readable app name shown on the consent screen

redirect_uri.description: OAuth redirect URI. For Auth.js v5: https://<domain>/api/auth/callback/google

email.description: Support email shown on the consent screen

function.name: gauth_renew_secret
function.description: Add a new client secret to an existing OAuth client and return it. Use when the secret was lost, leaked, or needs rotating. The previous secret keeps working until it is deleted in the console, so there is no downtime.

function.name: gauth_publish_status
function.description: Read whether the OAuth app is in Testing or Production, the test-user limit, and whether the Publish button is currently enabled.

function.name: gauth_list_test_users
function.description: List the email addresses currently allowed to sign in while the app is in Testing mode. An empty list means every login is rejected before it reaches the application.

function.name: gauth_add_test_users
function.description: Add email addresses to the consent screen's test-user allowlist. REQUIRED while the app is in Testing mode: with zero test users, Google rejects every login before the request reaches the application, leaving the application logs empty.

emails.description: Email addresses to allow. Each must be a Google account.

function.name: gauth_remove_test_users
function.description: Remove email addresses from the consent screen's test-user allowlist.

function.name: gauth_fill_branding
function.description: Set the branding fields of the consent screen. Google REQUIRES home page, privacy policy, terms of service and a developer contact email before an app can be published, and those URLs must be publicly reachable (a 404 is rejected). Pass only the fields you want to change; with no fields it returns the current values instead.

function.name: gauth_publish
function.description: Publish the OAuth app so it leaves Testing mode and is no longer capped at 100 users over its entire lifetime. Fails with blocked=true when the branding page is incomplete; that is a server-side precondition, so do not retry it — complete the branding first.
